description.zh: 迷雾森林的边缘地带，哥布林在此出没。教学引导区域。
description.en: The misty forest fringe, home to goblins. A teaching ground.

description.zh: 村庄北面的哥布林营地，哥布林王盘踞于此。教学引导区域。
description.en: A goblin camp north of the village, ruled by the Goblin King. A teaching ground.

r1.zh: 跟踪这群哥布林一路到这里——它们在村北扎了营。带上这背包精灵：就算死在地牢里，它也会把包里的东西驮回村庄；但穿在身上的装备救不回来。记住，一旦回到村庄，它就会消散。随时按 X 撤离。
r1.en: I've tracked these goblins all the way here — they've camped north of the village. Take this pack spirit: even if you die in the dungeon, it will carry your bag back to the village; but the equipment on your back is lost. Remember, it fades away once you return to the village. You can retreat with X at any time.

r2.zh: 进去前看清情报：里面有哥布林。比动量，谁高谁打中——它蓄力后那一击，别硬接。
r2.en: Read the intel before entering: there's a goblin inside. Compare momentum — whoever has more hits. When it charges, the next blow is heavy; don't take it head-on.

r3.zh: 药水在战斗里点一下就用掉了，占一回合，但关键时刻能救命。
r3.en: Potions are used in one click during battle, costing a turn — but they can save your life at the right moment.

r8.zh: 哥布林王在里头。打完这里，森林的路就开了。
r8.en: The Goblin King is inside. Defeat him and the road to the forest will open.

r2.zh: 攻击消耗 MP，休息回蓝。它正在蓄力——下一击很重，可以举盾减伤。
r2.en: Attacks cost MP; rest to recover. It's charging — the next blow is heavy. Raise your shield to cut the damage.
